name: nano-admin-for-looker
description: Looker Admin Extension with Google Cloud Function backend

scripts.extension:dev: npm run generate-hash && npm run dev --workspace=extension
scripts.extension:build: npm run generate-hash && npm run build --workspace=extension
scripts.backend:dev: npm run generate-hash && npm run dev --workspace=backend
scripts.backend:build: npm run generate-hash && npm run build --workspace=backend
scripts.backend:deploy: npm run generate-hash && gcloud functions deploy nano-admin-backend --gen2 --runtime=nodejs24 --region=us-central1 --trigger-http --allow-unauthenticated --entry-point=nanoAdminBackend --source=backend
scripts.dev: npm run generate-hash && (npm run dev --workspace=extension & npm run dev --workspace=backend)
